references.text: The priest shall examine the person and isolate them for seven days—the same procedure with a seven-day examination period
The priest declares the person clean, and they must wash their clothes—an identical concluding ritual involving purification and laundry
If the rash has not spread, the priest declares the person clean—the same principle that lack of spreading indicates cleanliness
If the mark has not spread, it is clean, and the priest shall declare them clean—a parallel assessment of skin condition
The one who is cleansed must wash their clothes—the same requirement for laundry as part of the purification ritual
The Levites were to wash their clothes as part of the cleansing—laundry as a purification rite
